judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD test-writing phase and never implemented the actual production code changes. While it updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and added acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/usageReporting.acceptance.test.ts`, `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` remains completely untouched. Consequently, the new acceptance test asserting summed usage across tool rounds will fail, the `afterModelResponse` signature parameter was not updated to `totalUsage`, and `CHANGELOG.md` was not updated. It also left a `.lore/dod.md` scratchpad file in the repository.
